hero.title: Crookie
hero.tagline: Born in Paris. Baked on Rua de S. Paulo.
hero.imageAlt: The Cookie House storefront on Rua de S. Paulo, with red doors and the cookie house sign

paris.label: Act I · Paris
paris.body: The crookie was born in Paris: croissant dough and cookie dough, in a single bite. When it reached Rua de S. Paulo, João Vaz Antunes and pastry chef Maksym Fishchunk did not copy it. They reinvented it. The precision of the layers stayed; Lisbon's nerve came in: pistachio and raspberry, hazelnut, dark chocolate with caramel and, yes, chouriço. Paris invented. Lisbon changed the recipe.
